contract_question: A DETERMINISTIC automated grounded-iterative scaffold (auto #check/exact?/apply?/hammer name-harvest + compile + error-read + bounded retry, NO human iteration, LLM-assembly held fixed) re-run on the n=3 ground truth C10/C15/C06: does it reproduce >=2/3 genuine closures — i.e. is the automatable-deterministic part the lever, or is the LLM-assembly step load-bearing?
